title: Zesty Fluffy Greek Tofu Gyro
description: A quick and easy Whole30-friendly Greek dish featuring marinated tofu, served in a fluffy gyro form.

ingredients.name: Extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into thin strips

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the tofu strips to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and cook the marinated tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the gyro by spreading a layer of hummus on the pita bread, followed by a few pieces of the cooked tofu, some diced tomato, sliced red onion, and cucumber.
Repeat the assembly process for the remaining ingredients.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
